metadata.title: Digital Dance: Motion Capture and New Forms
Digital Dance: Motion Capture and New Forms

sections.text: Digital technology has transformed dance in three separate ways: documentation (recording and analyzing performance), creation (digital tools as composition instruments), and performance (interactive, networked, and virtual dance). Each operates differently and raises different questions about what "dance" is when the body is mediated by technology.
